# Support

Gummisaurus is in development and does not yet have a supported release.
Please search open and closed repository issues before filing a report.

For a Gummisaurus bug or Vega compatibility issue, use:

* [Gummisaurus issues](https://github.com/brontodev/gummisaurus/issues)
* [Gummisaurus discussions](https://github.com/brontodev/gummisaurus/discussions)

For Jellyfin server configuration and administration, use the upstream
[Jellyfin documentation](https://jellyfin.org/docs/) and
[Jellyfin forum](https://forum.jellyfin.org/).

GitHub issues are for tracking enhancements and bugs, not general support.

The open source license grants you the freedom to use Gummisaurus.
It does not guarantee commitments of other people's time.
Please be respectful and manage your expectations.
